evidence.why: Two global definitions and complete literal initializer; no host functions.
Array and length populate IRAM task fields.

reason: Canonical declarations support the original array name, u16 types, symbolic byte count and requested alignment; the full file is data-only. Retention assesses source-object semantics, not independently verified compiled section layout.

evidence.why: Image and companion length definitions.
Registers image with DSP task and waits for initialization.
Boot sends image address, destination, length and initialization vector with mailbox waits.

reason: Existing purpose and data-flow explanations accurately describe image registration and serialized boot delivery, without decoding the opaque DSP words.
